title: 第九章 酒吧遇江莱第十章 设计师甘敬
content_zh:
夜莺酒吧。
这是一个名气很高的酒吧，虽然占地不宽，却装饰豪华，热闹非凡。
姜辰进入夜莺酒吧才发现这里比他想象中的热闹多了。
酒吧之中，熙熙攘攘，灯光闪烁之下，露出了各型各色不同的面容。有癫狂、兴奋、迷醉、同时也有新奇、迷茫、彷徨。
灯火阑珊，闪烁在每个人的脸庞上，劲爆的音乐衬托之下，如同灵蛇般疯狂地扭动着身躯的疯狂人们。
这里是男女相互猎艳的地方。
同时是十分混乱的地方，因为在这种地方打架是家常便饭。
这也造就了酒吧的疯狂与火爆！
夜晚，很难有什么地方比得上酒吧那般天天爆满。而特别是酒吧后台足够硬时，更受欢迎。
姜辰坐在前台的椅子上，随意点了一杯酒水，看着热闹熙攘的人群，寻找猎艳的目标。
“帅哥，一个人吗？”
一个妖艳女子来到了姜辰的身边，笑吟吟的看着他。
“不，我约了人。”姜辰笑着摇摇头。
之前聂星辰他都没有动，现在这个妖艳女子，他怎么可能看得上？
“扫兴。”
妖艳女子在酒吧混了这么多年，怎么会不知道姜辰在骗人？当下就冷哼一声，转身离开了。
“无趣。”
姜辰喝了一口酒，准备转身离开了酒吧。
系统的提示音响起。
【宿主，是否签到？】

“签到。”
姜辰心中一凛，但还是第一时间反应过来。
狗系统在这个时候提示签到就意味着有影视重要女主在旁边。
【恭喜宿主，签到成功，获得技能，法餐精通。】
“什么鬼玩样。”
姜辰差一点破口大骂。
法餐精通？
他又不是什么厨师，要这法餐精通干什么？
“江莱？”
看到这张和王漫妮有些相似的脸，姜辰有些恍惚。
这江莱可是《好先生》中的人物。没想到在这里遇到她。只是不知道现在江莱的那个男朋友自杀了没有，陆远回国了没有。
姜辰打量着江莱。
江莱拥有容颜绝美，气质冷冽，一身奢华的黑色礼服，紧贴身段，凸显出了她曼妙，玲珑的身段。
裙摆在大腿中间开叉，露出一双雪白，修长的玉腿，晶莹的玉足上，是一双昂贵，精致的高跟鞋。她肌肤很白，如冰肌玉骨般，一双美眸清冷，予人一种拒人千里之外的感觉，更有一种不食人间烟火般的气息。
和王漫妮相比江莱身上的大小姐气息尽显无遗。
“你认识我？”
江莱刚才坐在姜辰的不远处，不过她是一个人在喝酒，虽然有不少人去找他，但却没有一个人能够认出她的身份的，现在姜辰一口叫出她的名字让她很意外。
不过她可以确定，自己是不认识姜辰的。
“江氏集团大小姐。”姜辰笑了笑，说道：“我知道你。”
“你是不是对我有兴趣？”江莱走了过来。

“没兴趣。”姜辰摇摇头。
江莱是怎么样的人，他还不知道吗？
content_en:
Nightingale Bar.
This is a very famous bar. Although it occupies a small area, it is luxuriously decorated and very lively.
Jiang Chen entered the Nightingale Bar and found that the place was much livelier than he imagined.
The bar was bustling with people, and under the flickering lights, all kinds of faces were revealed. There is madness, excitement, and intoxication, but also novelty, confusion, and hesitation.
The dim lights flickered on everyone's faces, and against the backdrop of the explosive music, crazy people twisted their bodies like snakes.
This is a place where men and women hunt for each other.
It is also a very chaotic place, as fights are commonplace in such places.
This also makes the bar crazy and popular!
At night, it's hard to find any place as packed as a bar every day. And especially when the backstage of the bar is hard enough, it is more popular.
Jiang Chen sat on the chair at the front desk, casually ordered a glass of wine, and looked at the bustling crowd, looking for his target.
"Handsome, are you alone?"
A charming woman came to Jiang Chen's side and looked at him with a smile.
"No, I made an appointment." Jiang Chen smiled and shook his head.
He didn't move before Nie Xingchen. How could he like this charming woman now?
"Delightful."
How could a charming woman not know that Jiang Chen was lying after hanging out in bars for so many years? He snorted immediately, turned around and left.
"Boring."
Jiang Chen took a sip of wine and was about to turn around and leave the bar.
The system prompt sounds.
[Host, do you want to sign in? 】
"Sign in."
Jiang Chen's heart trembled, but he reacted immediately.
When the dog system prompts you to sign in at this time, it means that an important heroine of film and television is nearby.
[Congratulations to the host, you signed in successfully, acquired skills, and became proficient in French cuisine. 】
"What the hell are you playing?"
Jiang Chen almost cursed.
Proficient in French cuisine?
He's not much of a chef, so why would he need someone who is proficient in French cuisine?
"Jiang Lai?"
Seeing this face that was somewhat similar to Wang Manni's, Jiang Chen was in a daze.
This Jiang Lai is a character in "Mr. Good". I didn't expect to meet her here. I just don’t know if Jiang Lai’s boyfriend has committed suicide or if Lu Yuan has returned to China.
Jiang Chen looked at Jiang Lai.
Jiang Lai has a beautiful face and a cold temperament. She wears a luxurious black dress that hugs her figure and highlights her graceful and exquisite figure.
The skirt was slit in the middle of the thigh, revealing a pair of snow-white, slender jade legs, and a pair of expensive, exquisite high-heeled shoes on the crystal-clear jade feet. Her skin is as white as ice, and her beautiful eyes are cold, giving people a feeling of being repelled from thousands of miles away, and she also has an aura that is not like the fireworks of this world.
Compared with Wang Manni, Jiang Lai's ladylike aura is clearly evident.
"You know me?"
Jiang Lai was sitting not far from Jiang Chen just now, but she was drinking alone. Although many people came to look for him, no one could recognize her identity. Now Jiang Chen called her by name, which surprised her.
But she was certain that she didn't know Jiang Chen.
"The eldest lady of the Jiang Group." Jiang Chen smiled and said, "I know you."
"Are you interested in me?" Jiang Lai walked over.
"Not interested." Jiang Chen shook his head.
Doesn’t he know what kind of person Jiang Lai is?
